confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Chengdu price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable than hotel and cocktail anchors. The FX value was read from a search-result snippet attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page directly, so verify it on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on large second-tier Chinese tourist cities such as Chongqing and Xi'an, with prices set somewhat below Beijing and Shanghai. Cocktail and wine anchors were estimated from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker.
